extracted.intended_audience: people who make content for the BBC (journalists, producers, editors, online staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Landing/overview page for the BBC Editorial Guidelines that links to full editorial and online-services standards and related procedural guidance; intended as a navigation hub to standards for producing BBC content across TV, radio and online.

rubrics_metrics.name: BBC Editorial Guidelines — standards for all BBC content
rubrics_metrics.description: The BBC Editorial Guidelines outline the standards the BBC expects of all BBC content on TV, radio and online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They are designed for everyone who makes content for the BBC, to help them deal with difficult editorial decisions. The site provides the Editorial Guidelines in full (by section and by A to Z) and links to related policy pages and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online Services Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate set of guidance for online content; available 'By section and by A to Z' and reachable from this hub. Intended to complement the general Editorial Guidelines with online-specific standards and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience interactivity guidance (competitions, voting and awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: New Guidance has now been published for all audience competitions, voting and awards
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance specifically addressing audience-facing interactive formats (competitions, voting, awards). Implies there are special rules and safeguards for interactive audience activity that content-makers must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / 'Text only' site options
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site provides accessibility help and a 'Text only' option, indicating an editorial/process expectation to consider accessibility in content delivery (e.g., formats and presentation that aid access).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural/Compliance resources (Mandatory Referrals, Forms, Compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mandatory Referrals; Forms; Research Reports; Compliance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Navigation items indicate procedural requirements and compliance mechanisms (e.g., mandatory referrals, forms to be used, compliance and research reporting). The landing page lists these resources but does not give the substantive procedural rules on this page.
